title: First light
text:
One site, different rhythms
The home page moves continuously. A post should do the opposite. It should give an idea enough room to unfold, while preserving the same typography, color and visual language.
The blog will eventually bring together older posts and new experiments. Quarto can render only what changed, and freeze: auto lets computational results remain stable until their source needs to run again.
For now, this page is simply checking the transition from the animated landing to a quieter reading experience.
